description: This source file contains test suite definitions for the ShareToAgentDeepLink component, verifying behavior of message building, URL encoding, deep link parsing, and settings management within the iOS app's sharing feature.

classes.name: ShareToAgentDeepLinkTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of ShareToAgentDeepLink functionalities, including message content, URL generation, parsing, and settings persistence.

methods.name: buildMessageIncludesSharedFields

methods.name: shareInstructionSettingsRoundTrip
